evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/listings.rs — ~36 call sites interpolate the raw sqlx/repository error `e` directly into the client-facing response body via `format!("Failed to ... {}", e)` (e.g. lines 140, 188, 214, 278, 310, 321, 347, 376, 429, 453, 799, 855, 914, 1012). Because these handlers return `(axum::http::StatusCode, String)` the formatted string is sent verbatim as the HTTP body, leaking internal DB detail (table/column/constraint names, SQL error text) to API clients — an information-disclosure smell.

Sibling route files in the same churned segment use the structured, redacting convention instead: unit_residents.rs and automation.rs return `ApiResult<T>` with `ErrorResponse::new("DB_ERROR", "Database error")` / the `db_error(...)` helper (40 and 20 refs respectively), which logs `%e` server-side via tracing but returns only a generic code+message to the client. listings.rs diverges from this house pattern.

Fix: route listings.rs error branches through the api-core `ErrorResponse`/`db_error` helper so the raw `e` is logged server-side only and the client receives a generic code+message. Confidence medium: confirmed statically (error type is `String`, 21 handler signatures at lines 37/131/165/302/343/368/419/477/538/638/... return `(StatusCode, String)`); not runtime-confirmed which specific sqlx errors surface.

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/listings.rs — 21 handlers (lines 37, 131, 165, 302, 343, 368, 419, 477, 538, 638, ... through 1012) return `Result<T, (axum::http::StatusCode, String)>`, emitting plaintext String error bodies. The rest of api-server returns the JSON `ErrorResponse { code, message }` contract (via `ApiResult`), which is what the OpenAPI spec and the generated TS/Kotlin clients expect for error responses.

Impact: clients cannot parse a stable error `code` from listings endpoints, and error bodies are text/plain rather than the documented application/json ErrorResponse schema — an API-contract inconsistency that makes error handling on these endpoints diverge from every other route group. This is the same root cause as code-review-listings-rs-raw-db-error-leak but is separately landable: migrating listings.rs handlers to `ApiResult` + `ErrorResponse` fixes both the raw-error leak and the contract divergence.

Fix: migrate the 21 listings.rs handlers from `(StatusCode, String)` to `ApiResult<T>` with `ErrorResponse`/`db_error`/`not_found` helpers, matching unit_residents.rs and automation.rs. Static-analysis only; no runtime reproduction.
